speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To understand the cause of your double vision, upper limb weakness, and difficulty climbing stairs, which started first and has been getting worse?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: The pattern of symptoms worsening with activity and improving with rest is highly suggestive of a specific neuromuscular junction disorder. Given your double vision and proximal muscle weakness, have you noticed any drooping of your eyelids or difficulty swallowing?

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had recent infections or fevers, and there is no family history of neurological disease. The weakness feels symmetrical in both arms and legs.

speaker: Doctor
